description: Alembic migration script for converting primary keys and foreign keys from integer IDs to UUIDs in 'user' and 'item' tables, including upgrade and downgrade procedures.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema changes to replace integer IDs with UUIDs, including adding new columns, populating them, and updating constraints.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the schema changes, restoring integer IDs and associated constraints.
